question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Authoritative
solution:
The correct answer is: **Weak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Authoritative"** refers to something or someone having authority, being commanding, reliable, or confident. It implies possession of power or influence. (प्रामाणिक, अधिकारपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher has an authoritative tone that demands respect from the students.
 
 
 
• **"Weak"** is the opposite of authoritative, referring to someone or something lacking strength, power, or influence. (कमज़ोर)
 
 
• **Example:** His arguments were weak and failed to convince the audience.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Authoritative'** is **'Weak'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Weak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mutiny **(विद्रोह): A rebellion or uprising against authority.

 
 
• **Example:** The sailors staged a mutiny against their captain.
 
 
 
• **Incredible **(अविश्वसनीय): Something so extraordinary that it is hard to believe.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician performed an incredible trick that amazed the audience.
 
 
 
• **Strong** (मज़बूत): Having great power, influence, or physical strength.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a strong character and never backs down from a challenge.
